meta.scope: UAE Batch 4 — Official recurring series under new data spec: CPI, national accounts, monetary/banking statistics, population. Evidence-grade dependencies only; unsupported links in _dropped.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index (CPI)
reports.description: Official consumer price index measuring changes in the prices of a basket of goods and services. Released on a regular cadence and used as the primary domestic inflation measure.

reports.title: National Accounts (GDP)
reports.description: Official national accounts estimates of gross domestic product and related aggregates, covering both oil and non-oil activity.

reports.title: Monthly Statistical Bulletin — Banking & Monetary Statistics
reports.description: Monthly compilation of monetary aggregates (M1, M2, M3), central-bank assets and liabilities, gross international reserves, bank deposits, credit and related banking indicators.

reports.title: Population estimates
reports.description: Official population estimates for the UAE, reflecting the large non-national component of the resident population.

reports.title: Balance of Payments
reports.description: Official balance-of-payments statistics compiled according to BPM6, covering the current, capital and financial accounts.

_dropped.why: While central-bank monetary analysis routinely references CPI, no specific CBUAE or FCSC document was located in this pass that explicitly states a methodological or data dependency of the Monthly Statistical Bulletin on the FCSC CPI series with a quotable claim.
National accounts commonly use CPI or related price indices for deflation, but no FCSC methodological note was retrieved in this pass that states the precise relationship with a quotable sentence.
BOP and national accounts are conceptually linked under BPM6/SNA, but no UAE-specific document was found in this pass that asserts a concrete data or methodological dependency with a direct quote.

_dropped.edge: oil production series (not yet a node) -> ae-national-accounts
_dropped.why: Hydrocarbon production is a major component of UAE GDP. A dedicated oil-production report node was not created in this batch because no clean domain tag exists for energy production (energy-royalties is the closest but does not fit production volumes). Deferred until domain list can be extended or a better fit is confirmed.

_dropped.edge: tourism / visitor arrivals (not yet a node) -> ae-national-accounts
_dropped.why: Tourism is a significant services component. No domain tag cleanly covers tourism or visitor statistics; deferred.

_dropped.edge: ports / container throughput (not yet a node) -> ae-national-accounts or trade
_dropped.why: Logistics is central to Dubai’s non-oil economy. No domain tag for trade or logistics; deferred pending domain guidance.
